caseName: Red Ball Motor Freight, Inc. v. United States
caseNameFull: Red Ball Motor Freight, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Reagan Sayers and R. E. Kidwell for appellants. Solicitor General Perlman and Daniel W. Knowlton for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission; and Carl L. Phinney for the Herrin Transportation Co., appellees.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas. Per Curiam: The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed. United States v. Detroit & Cleveland Navigation Co., 326 U. S. 236; Interstate Commerce Commission v. Parker, 326 U. S. 60.
